title: Overgrown Ruins
text: Vines cover the walls of a building that should not be here. A stair leads down into the dark.

pass.text: Carvings on the walls tell a story, and you copy them down.
At the bottom, on an altar, something waits for a new owner.

fail.text: The stair goes down much farther than the hill is tall. You come back up bleeding and shaking.

effects.text: Some doors are better left closed.

fail.text: You wander the ruins for hours and find only snakes.

title: Caught in a Storm
text: The sky turns black in minutes. There is no shelter anywhere.

pass.text: You dig in and wait it out.

fail.text: The storm batters you for a day and a night.

title: A Local Guide
text: A guide offers to show you the paths that are not on any map, for a price.

then.text: She takes you to a place where the locals leave offerings, and tells you why.

fail.text: You get lost for a day.

title: A Strange Campfire
text: You see a campfire in the distance and walk toward it.

outcomes.text: Hunters share their food and their fire.
The fire is cold. The footprints around it lead away in a perfect circle.
Something is sitting by the fire. It turns to look at you.

title: Something in the Trees
text: The birds stop singing. Branches crack behind you, too high off the ground.

title: A Weathered Shrine
text: A small stone shrine stands by the path. Someone leaves fresh offerings here every day.

effects.text: You feel lighter as you walk on.
The wind follows you all day.
You leave the shrine as you found it.

title: The Lost Expedition
text: You find the camp of an expedition that went missing last spring. The tents are still standing.

pass.text: Their supplies and their notes are still here.

fail.text: You find out what happened to them.

title: Bad Water
text: Your canteen is empty, and the only water for miles is a still green pool.

pass.text: You boil it and drink, and your stomach holds.

fail.text: By evening you are shaking with fever.

title: The Standing Stones
text: A ring of tall stones stands on a bare hill. They hum when the wind blows.

pass.text: The stones are a calendar, and it counts down to a date that is very close.

fail.text: You step inside the ring, and the sun is suddenly in the wrong place.

title: The Hermit
text: An old hermit lives in a cave with a thousand candles. He knows why you have come.

pass.text: He teaches you a spell, and makes you promise never to use it for yourself. You lie.

fail.text: He throws stones at you until you leave.

title: The Ravine
text: The trail runs along the edge of a deep ravine. At the bottom you can see a body.

pass.text: You climb down safely. The dead man was carrying a satchel.

fail.text: The rock gives way under your boot.

title: Lights Over the Hills
text: Pale lights drift over the hills at night, in formation.

pass.text: You follow them until dawn and see where they land.

fail.text: You wake up miles away, with no memory of the night.
